definitions.short: to chastise , literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence, to instruct
definitions.usage: bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.
definitions.full: H3256. yasar [ יָסַר ] verb discipline, chasten, admonish (Talmud יִ(י)סּוֺר ᵑ7 chastisement ; but Aramaic יְסַר is bind ) — Qal Imperfect 3masculine suffix וְיִסְּרֵנִי Isa 8:11 (Di De SS see Bo § 1103 Ew § 249 d , but Thes MV Che and others Pi`el Perfect); 1 singular suffix וְאֶסְֳּרֵם Hosea 10:10 (Ges § 71 ); Infinitive absolute יָסֹר 1Chr 15:22 (noun Ke, point as participle Öttli); Participle יֹסֵר Prov 9:7 ; Psa 94:10 ; יסורי Jer 17:13 Kt see סוּר ; — 1 admonish Isa 8:11 (followed by suffix + מִלֶּכֶת away from walking , i. e. not to walk), Prov 9:7 (|| מוֺכִיחַ ). 2 instruct , 1Chr 15:22 . 3 discipline , of God Hosea 10:10 ; Psa 94:10 . Niph`al Imperfect עֶ֫בֶד יִוָּ֫סֶר Prov 29:19 ; אִוָּסֵר Jer 31:18 ; תִּוָּסְרוּ Lev 26:23 ; Imperative feminine הִוָּסְרִי Jer 6:8 ; masculine plural הִיָסְרוּ Psa 2:10 ; — (Niph`al tolerate. , Ges § 51 . 2), let oneself be corrected, admonished by words of man 2:10 ; Prov 29:19 ); let oneself be chastened by discipline of God Jer 6:8 ; 31:18 ; Lev 26:23 . Pi`el Perfect יִסַּר 1Kin 12:11 3 t.; suffix יִסְּרַנִּי Psa 118:18 ; יִסְּרוֺ Isa 28:26 ; 3 feminine suffix יִסְּרַתּוּ Prov 31:1-2 ;masculine יִסַּרְתָּ Psa 39:12 ; Job 4:3 , etc. + 8 t. Perfect; Imperfect יְיַסֵּר Deut 8:5 ; 2 masculine suffix תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ Psa 94:12 , etc. + 5 t. Imperfect; Imperative יַסֵּר Prov 19:18 ; 29:17 ; suffix יַסְּרֵנִי Jer 10:24 ; Infinitive absolute יַסֹּר Psa 118:18 ; construct יַסְּרָה Lev 26:18 ; suffix יַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ Deut 4:36 ; Participle מְיַסְּרֶ֑ךָּ 8:5 ; — 1 discipline, correct (the moral nature, with more or less severity according to circumstances): a. of God , with accusative Hosea 7:15 (of training arms), Deut 4:36 (see Dr), 8:5 (Israel as son), Isa 28:26 , happy the man יהּ תיסרנו אשׁר Psa 94:12 118:18 (twice in verse) b. of man , with accusative Deut 8:5 ; Prov 19:18 ; 29:17 (all of a father his son), Job 4:3 ; Prov 31:1 ; Psa 16:7 my reins (the emotions of my own heart) correct, admonish me. 2 more severely , chasten, chastise: a. of God , followed by accusative of person, Jer 31:18 ; תְיַסְּרֵנִי אַלבַּֿחֲמָֽתְךָ Psa 6:2 ; 38:2 ; באף אל בְּמשׁפט Jer 10:24 ; למשׁפט 30:11 = 46:28 ; חטאת על Lev 26:18 , 28 ; עון על בתוכחות Psa 39:12 . b. of man , a father his son Deut 21:18 ; elders a man 22:18 (including, as perhaps 21:18 , bodily chastisement); a king his subjects בַּשּׁוֺטִים and בָּעַקְרַבִּים 1Kin 12:11 , 14 2Chr 10:11 , 14 . c. רָֽעָתֵךְ תְּיַסְּרֵךְ Jer 2:19 thy badness will chastise thee. Nithp. Perfect נִוַּסְּרוּ Ezek 23:48 (for נִתְוַסְּרוּ Ges § 55 R. 7); passive be disciplined, corrected.
